How/When to use 'will' and '(be) going to'?

We use 'will', when decide to do something at the time of speaking:
-Ann is in hospital -> Oh really? I'll visit her.

We use '(be) going to' when we have already decided to do something.
-Ann is in hospital -> Yes, I know. I am going to visit her.
Using: If I do - I will / If I did - I would

1) If I find my document, I will call you -> Durchaus wahrscheinlich, daher 'If I do - I will'
2) If I found 1000000 EUR, I would call you. -> Unwahrscheinlich, daher 'If I did - I would'
